description: The alerts our system can send to your agent about a coin: price above/below, 24-hour and 7-day change, market cap, volume, crowd emotion and belief network strength (Animal Spirits), buzz and mentions in 24 hours; how often they are checked and how they are delivered. No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
